inventory_boundary.source_ref: raw/paper.pdf (15 pages including embedded Supplemental Material) and paper-source/arxiv_v2_main.tex
known_items: one no-display analytic claim from Supplement Eq. (S17)
inventory_boundary.reason: The complete paper and supplement were read end to end. TeX was used only to verify captions and equations; author numerical code, author arrays, and source pixels were not used as scientific inputs.

acceptance_criteria: All 24 existing paper-scale target contracts in config/paper_scale.json pass on hash-valid immutable jobs; aggregation refuses any missing shard.
Eigen residuals are <=2e-6, N_b=600 steady residuals are <=2e-8, trace errors are <=2e-8, and semiclassical sphere-norm drift is <=2e-6.
Small-N backend parity passes before paper-scale acceptance.
No numerical process reads paper pixels, digitized curves, author code, author arrays, raw paper files, or the network.
Execution alone cannot promote paper-exact or paper-error status without independent checks and fresh review.
For every declared paper-scale N, eta is fitted from the generated magnetization time series using a frozen damped-oscillation model; no Liouvillian eigenvalue enters the fit.
Every fit meets the frozen R-squared threshold and emits its generated trace and fitted prediction.
Substitution of both printed and independently rederived fixed points into Supplement Eq. (S13) records RHS and unit-norm residuals and verifies the stated transition value.
A discrepancy remains a review candidate; this implementation never promotes it to a paper error by itself.
